name: Blasphemous God Staff Jax (Chroma)
creator: etherroot
description:
This mod is a custom chroma created specifically for the God Staff Jax skin. The entire look has been thoroughly reworked, replacing the original golden, celestial theme with a dark, blasphemous aesthetic featuring deep purple hues, matte black armor, and ashen skin, alongside matching purple visual effects (VFX).

    Note: To use this mod, you must own and select the **God Staff Jax** skin in-game.
